newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech fund CNIS under Finmin forced admin - paper. [CORRECTED 08:52 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Czech fund CNIS under Finmin forced admin - paper. [CORRECTED 08:52 GMT]

text.p: The Czech Finance Ministry has placed the investment fund CNIS under forced administration, following several irregularities in the management of its funds, the daily Mlada Fronta Dnes reported on Tuesday.
(Corrects title and text to make clear CNIS is reported to be under Finance Ministry, not Central Bank, administration).

The paper, quoting Jan Veverka of the Finance Ministry, said CNIS violated laws by overstating the value of some of its real estate, buying non-tradeable shares of related companies, and using real estate as collateral for related companies.
